method.note: FIGURES FROM A PRODUCT PAGE, NO DRAWING. NavePoint publishes no datasheet or drawing for this part. The held page (NavePoint product page for 00401654 (navepoint-1u-rack-mount-cable-management-panel-with-tidy-brush-slot-black.txt, saved 2026-11-11)) gives External Height 1.75", External Width 0.31", External Depth 19", Venting Style Non-vented, Lip Flanged, Rack Capacity 1U, Material Cold Rolled Steel, Finish Powder Coated and the hardware (four M6 screws, washers and cage nuts). It gives no size or place for the brush slot or the support bar: the slot is drawn as a window in the middle of the panel and its size is estimated. No product photograph is held, so the shape was not checked and nothing was copied.
